title: Grade 2
summary: Minim and quaver beats, triplets, rest grouping, two ledger lines, A/B♭/E♭ major and A/E/D harmonic minor.

units.title: New simple time signatures and triplets
Grouping notes and rests; two ledger lines
units.learnerTitle: Neat rhythms and high and low notes
units.summary: Note and rest grouping in all Grade 1–2 times; two ledger lines.

units.title: A, B flat and E flat major
units.summary: Three new major scales, key-signature order and their tonic triads and degrees.

units.title: Relative keys and harmonic minor
units.summary: Minor scales (harmonic form), relative keys, A/E/D minor.
refinements: Book §11 (melodic minor) and the melodic half of §9 are deferred to G3-U4; an optional preview is offered here and is never assessed.

units.title: Intervals, terms and melody reading
units.summary: Interval numbers above the tonic in major and minor keys; new terms and signs in context.

nodes.title: Minim beats: 2/2, 3/2 and 4/2
nodes.objective: Read time signatures with minim beats and count them.

nodes.title: Quaver beats: 3/8
nodes.objective: Read 3/8 and compare it with 3/4.

nodes.title: Duple, triple and quadruple
nodes.objective: Describe any Grade 1–2 time signature as duple, triple or quadruple, and explain why 2/2 and 4/4 can look alike.

nodes.title: Triplets
nodes.objective: Read and write triplets: three notes in the time of two.

nodes.title: Triplets with rests and mixed values
nodes.objective: Read triplet groups that contain rests or mixed values adding up to three equal notes.

nodes.title: Practice: New beats and triplets
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Review: Grade 1 foundations
nodes.objective: Revisit earlier material so it stays fresh.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: New beats and triplets
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: Grouping notes in the new times
nodes.objective: Beam notes correctly in 2/2, 3/2, 4/2 and 3/8.

nodes.title: A new rest for each silent beat
nodes.objective: Write rests so that each silent beat starts with a new rest.

nodes.title: Two-beat rests in four-beat bars
nodes.objective: Use two-beat rests for the first or last half of a four-beat bar, but not the middle.

nodes.title: Rests for part of a beat
nodes.objective: Write rests for half-beats and quarter-beats in the right order.

nodes.title: Two ledger lines
nodes.objective: Read and write notes with up to two ledger lines above or below each stave.

nodes.title: The same note in two clefs
nodes.objective: Recognise the same pitch written with ledger lines in one clef or on the stave in the other.

nodes.title: Practice: Neat rhythms and high and low notes
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Review: earlier units
nodes.objective: Spaced review of earlier units in this grade, mixed with the new unit.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: Neat rhythms and high and low notes
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: A major
nodes.objective: Build A major and explain why it needs three sharps.

nodes.title: B flat and E flat major
nodes.objective: Build B♭ and E♭ major — scales that start on a black key.

nodes.title: Key signatures up to three sharps or flats
nodes.objective: Write major key signatures in the correct order and positions in both clefs.

nodes.title: Tonic triads and degrees in the new major keys
nodes.objective: Build tonic triads and name degrees by number in A, B♭ and E♭ major.

nodes.title: Practice: New major keys
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Review: earlier units
nodes.objective: Spaced review of earlier units in this grade, mixed with the new unit.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: New major keys
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: What makes a scale minor?
nodes.objective: Hear and see the difference between major and minor, focusing on the semitone between degrees 2 and 3.

nodes.title: Relative major and minor
nodes.objective: Find the relative minor of C, G and F major and the relative major of A, E and D minor.

nodes.title: Harmonic minor: raising the 7th
nodes.objective: Build a harmonic minor scale by raising the 7th degree.

nodes.title: A, E and D harmonic minor
nodes.objective: Write A, E and D harmonic minor in both clefs, with and without key signatures.

nodes.title: Minor key signatures and tonic triads
nodes.objective: Write minor key signatures and tonic triads, and name degrees in A, E and D minor.

nodes.title: Coming later: the melodic minor
nodes.objective: Optional preview of the melodic minor scale, which becomes required in Grade 3.

nodes.title: Practice: Minor keys
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Review: earlier units
nodes.objective: Spaced review of earlier units in this grade, mixed with the new unit.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: Minor keys
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: Intervals in the new keys
nodes.objective: Give the number of intervals above the tonic in all Grade 2 major and minor keys.

nodes.title: More tempo and character words
nodes.objective: Understand the Grade 2 tempo and character terms.

nodes.title: Accents and touch signs
nodes.objective: Recognise accents, semi-staccato, staccatissimo and tenuto signs.

nodes.title: Little words that change a direction
nodes.objective: Learn seven small Italian words that join with other words to make a direction.

nodes.title: More, less, very and too much
nodes.objective: Learn words that say how much: more, less, very and too much, and the word for movement.

nodes.title: More tempo and character words
nodes.objective: Learn six more words of speed and character: allargando, grave, larghetto, giocoso, simile and vivo.

nodes.title: Wedge, pointed accent and dots under a slur
nodes.objective: Recognise three more signs that show how to touch a note: the wedge, the pointed accent and dots under a slur.

nodes.title: Looking closely at a melody (Grade 2)
nodes.objective: Answer questions about an original melody using Grades 1–2 knowledge.

nodes.title: Practice: Intervals and expression
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Grade review
nodes.objective: Cumulative spaced review of the whole grade before the unit challenge and grade assessment.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: Intervals and expression
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: Grade 2 assessment
nodes.objective: An independent, hint-free assessment that samples every Grade 2 outcome and earlier essentials.
